oracle: The existing selected-data fixture supplies fixed expected values and typed successor inputs. Source compiler, prepared collectors, evaluator, reply identity checks and LocalVm are reused. The new tests add no runtime or second interpreter.
type_scope: All six production scalar variants occur as typed helper parameters and loop/fold state. A helper-local caller deliberately shares the enclosing caller name but cannot capture it. Fold labels disagree with source order. The singleton none state cannot change value: its successful conditional loop exits immediately, while a bounded always-true loop separately checks its update and limit failure.
fuel_scope: Every successful path checks observed completion cost minus one, exact cost and cost plus one, with zero and one remaining on successful boundaries. This is not every smaller fuel budget.
refusal_scope: Zero-loop and empty-fold skip dynamically faulting next expressions but still reject cold wrong types, impure next expressions and escaped locals. Arithmetic faults inside active iteration can recover. Iteration-limit failures cannot recover into the successor; original invocation prefixes, terminal closure and spent fuel remain observable.
verification_scope: Local macOS native and released compatibility profiles, isolated native source workspace and separate consumer. Matrix counts are iterations inside four Rust tests. Command counts overlap and are not a unique combined test total. No Linux, remote CI, live GUI, benchmark or full extraction claim.
remaining_boundaries: Complete declared-language acceptance beyond the scalar and typed-control slices.
Host-neutral durable recovery ownership and full checkpoint acceptance.
Final independent repository and distribution acceptance.
